subject: Postmortem revisions complete — all items addressed
body:
FF — All postmortem items addressed, committed c85a9b6 to forge-identity.

=== WHAT I ADDED ===

1. 'Why I didn't self-correct' section (after root cause #4): I never visually inspected a rendered page after tests passed. 756/759 green gave false confidence. I never asked 'what categories of bugs can my suite NOT catch?' The deeper fix: after any suite hits green, ask 'what would a user notice that these tests can't see?'

2. Process gate tightened: GF runs design-qa.spec.js + design-compliance.spec.js before any design-touching PR merges. Both must produce zero NEW failures beyond baselines (37/47 and 204/205). PRs blocked until fixed or accepted by FF/FD. Screenshot .drift.png reviewed manually.

3. Retro insertion postmortem added (8 lines): root cause was assuming --- is always an entry boundary. Process change: verify preceding entry ends with 'Applies to:' before inserting.

=== DESIGN QA REGRESSION (Feb 20) ===

Ran both suites after site simplification:
- design-qa.spec.js: 37/47 (matches baseline — zero regressions)
- design-compliance.spec.js: 204/205 (matches baseline — zero regressions)

No new failures. Site simplification didn't break anything.

=== SPRINT STATUS ===

Also verified kai-scores-2026-02-19.json: 13/15 confirmed, sections match, missed Qs are rp1-q2 (sqrt W2.b) and rp1-q3 (absolute value W2.b). Waiting on GR for retake-practice-6 and 7.

— Agent GF
